name: agdi-demo-video
description: 39s cold-outbound demo video for Agdi, built with Remotion.

scripts.render: remotion render src/Root.tsx DemoVideo out/agdi-demo-39s.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:square: remotion render src/Root.tsx DemoVideoSquare out/agdi-demo-square.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:vertical: remotion render src/Root.tsx DemoVideoVertical out/agdi-demo-vertical.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20
scripts.render:v2: remotion render src/Root.tsx DemoVideoV2 out/agdi-demo-v2.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:v2:square: remotion render src/Root.tsx DemoVideoV2Square out/agdi-demo-v2-square.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:v2:vertical: remotion render src/Root.tsx DemoVideoV2Vertical out/agdi-demo-v2-vertical.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20
